snippet.title: Balitti - Teaser Trailer
snippet.description: A frenetic movement FPS inked like a manga: run, slide and fly across the map on a kunai rope, tear through hordes in the arenas and chain kills into combos to push your style rank. Insane movement, colossal bosses and worlds where gravity doesn't play fair.
